summary: Asking if she can afford a new boiler
question_text: Can I afford a new boiler?

briefing.asking: Margaret wants to know whether she can afford a new boiler.

numbers.label: Putting aside £20 a month for a year

things_to_check: Is her current boiler failing, or is she planning ahead?
Ask if she has a quote, as costs vary a lot.
Mention that free help is available from MoneyHelper and Citizens Advice.
Remind her not to share her details with anyone who phones her about it.

helper_note: Talked it through. No quote yet. Suggest a heating pot, £20 a month, and getting a quote first.

draft.text:
Dear Margaret,

Thank you for your question about a new boiler. Last month you had £230 left over. If you put £20 a month aside, that would be £240 in a year. Boilers cost very different amounts, so the best first step is to get a quote. Priya has agreed to help you with that. Free, independent help is available from MoneyHelper and Citizens Advice.

With best wishes,
Priya
